name: keepgoing
description: Durable AI jobs that continue substantial work without repeated continue prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Keep substantial AI work progressing as one durable job.
interface.longDescription: KeepGoing preserves substantial AI work as a durable job so ChatGPT can continue, check, resume, and recover the same objective without repeatedly restarting it.
defaultPrompt: Use KeepGoing to finish this substantial job until it is complete.
